remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place. March 1946. . . . No signature" [notes Intimate Gallery label from backing inscription 3]. Abiquiú Notebooks after 1977 indicates, "Sold by Halpert, Oct. 1958." Reproduced and titled *Slightly Open Shell* in *America & Alfred Stieglitz* (1934). (Source: Lynes, 1999)

titles.title: Slightly Open Shell

description: An open clamshell, seen from above, runs the length of this narrow composition. The point where the two white shells join is painted black, and the interior grooves of the shell are just visible. The shell sits on a plain white background.
imageCaption: Courtesy of Wadsworth Atheneum Museum of Art.
title: Slightly Open Clam Shell
